(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; Al Jazeera's own reporting language)
Yotova, who advocates for dialogue with Russia and opposes military aid to Ukraine, received 58 percent of the vote in Sunday's run-off according to several polling agencies' counts. Her opponent, former interim Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov, trailed at about 38 percent. The vote was the first major test for Prime Minister Rumen Radev's Moscow-friendly Progressive Bulgaria party, which endorsed Yotova.
